## Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the scenario where you'd use it.

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. If you have a specific implementation in mind, outline it here.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds or alternative approaches?

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other tools, etc.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have checked the [Roadmap](../ROADMAP.md) and this feature is not already planned
- [ ] I have searched [existing issues](https://github.com/Zullllkar/vibeboard/issues) for similar requests
